summary: REFRESH (prior report Sep 29, 2026): commercial traction keeps building (26 systems sold, €102M+ backlog, Telefónica Madrid, Eldorado Brazil, TTM revenue +91%), and the stock keeps falling: ~15% since Sep 29, to a 52-week low.
